req.title: Handle CORS pre-flight OPTIONS
req.statement: The system shall respond to OPTIONS requests with appropriate Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that OPTIONS requests to any endpoint return HTTP 2xx with Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers headers. httpbin uses Flask-CORS or manual CORS handling. We test: (1) positive — OPTIONS to a known endpoint returns 200 with both CORS headers present and non-empty; (2) negative — OPTIONS to a non-existent path returns 4xx (client error, not 2xx); (3) boundary — OPTIONS with an Origin header triggers the pre-flight response with exact header values; (4) decision-table — OPTIONS without Origin still returns 2xx; (5) equivalence — Access-Control-Allow-Methods contains expected HTTP verbs. Tests assert exact status codes and exact header presence to kill constant-mutation and comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_allow_methods_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send OPTIONS request to /get with Origin and Access-Control-Request-Method headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_allow_methods_header():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods')
    assert allow_methods is not None
    assert len(allow_methods) > 0

test_cors_preflight_options_returns_200_with_allow_methods_header()

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_path_returns_4xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error (unknown route)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_nonexistent_path_returns_4xx():
    r = client.options(
        '/nonexistent-path-xyz-does-not-exist',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_get_and_post
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS to /get with Origin header
Inspect Access-Control-Allow-Methods for GET and POST
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: decision table — CORS allow-methods must include standard HTTP verbs
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_get_and_post():
    r = client.options(
        '/get',
        headers={
            'Origin': 'http://example.com',
            'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET'
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    allow_methods = r.headers.get('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', '')
    assert 'GET' in allow_methods
    assert 'POST' in allow_methods

test_cors_preflight_options_allow_methods_contains_get_and_post()

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send OPTIONS to /get WITHOUT an Origin header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-039: boundary — OPTIONS without Origin header; catches boolean-negation on Origin check

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_cors_preflight_options_without_origin_still_returns_2xx():
    r = client.options('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200

    assert r.status_code != 400
